t: 法国物理学家奥古斯丁-让·弗雷斯内尔(Augustin-Jean Fresnel)在向科学院宣…
te: French physicist Augustin-Jean Fresnel, in a memoir read to the Academy of Sciences, coins the terms linear polarizatio…
dz: 法国物理学家奥古斯丁-让·弗雷斯内尔(Augustin-Jean Fresnel)在向科学院宣读的回忆录中将线性分化,循环分化,和椭圆分化等术语铸成硬币,并报道了一次直接折射实验来验证他关于光学自转是一种双光形式的理论.
de: French physicist Augustin-Jean Fresnel, in a memoir read to the Academy of Sciences, coins the terms linear polarization, circular polarization, and elliptical polarization, and reports a direct refraction experiment verifying his theory that optical rotation is a form of birefringence.
